attributes.title: Hot Topics in Neonatology 2026
attributes.credits_text: 18 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 18 AAPA Cat 1 · 18 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
The main conference runs December 7 to 9, 2026, at Gaylord National, with a Neonatal Quality Conference as a paid add-on on December 6. You can attend in person or by live stream, and moving from in-person to streaming carries no fee, a useful fallback for a December trip.

Nemours designates up to 18 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with ABP MOC, ABS Continuous Certification, AAPA and ANCC credit also listed. The early rate has ended: physicians now pay $925, and nurses, APPs, residents and fellows pay $725. The organizer lists 2027 for December 5 to 8 at the Marriott Marquis.
